description: This file contains shell functions and scripts for managing firmware upgrades, including installing files, handling images, and interacting with device partitions.

methods.name: install_file
methods.description: Copies files to a RAM root, handling symbolic links and creating necessary directories.

methods.name: install_bin
methods.description: Installs a binary file and its libraries if executable.

methods.name: run_hooks
methods.description: Executes a list of functions with a given argument.

methods.name: ask_bool
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no answer with a default.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Outputs verbose messages if verbosity level is high.

methods.name: json_string
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON output.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Reads a file and optionally decompresses it based on magic bytes.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Gets the magic word (first two bytes) of a file.

methods.name: get_magic_long
methods.description: Gets the magic long (first four bytes) of a file.

methods.name: export_bootdevice
methods.description: Exports boot device information based on kernel command line.

methods.name: export_partdevice
methods.description: Exports partition device information based on major/minor numbers.

methods.name: hex_le32_to_cpu
methods.description: Converts a little-endian 32-bit hex string to CPU order.

methods.name: get_partitions
methods.description: Reads partition table from a device.

methods.name: default_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade by writing image to MTD device.
